in_sanskrit.name: Sharveera
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of power and strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharveera एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharveera is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Sharva' meaning 'God of Power' and 'Iina' meaning 'Goddess'. The name Sharveera is a tribute to the Goddess of power and strength. It represents a woman who is powerful, strong, and beautiful.
